inv.desc_en:
Commercial Property for Rent | 190.80 m² | 15-Year Contract | +4.07% Profitability | €975,000

Secure investment with stable income from day one.

Commercial property of 190.80 m² for sale with a consolidated tenant and a 15-year lease agreement, generating an annual profitability of 4.07%.

Located at c/ Arcos de la Frontera s/n, an area of high visibility and traffic, this asset is ideal for those looking for security, constant income, and low tenant turnover.

Key features:

Area: 190.80 m²

Current contract: 15 years

Net profitability: 4.07% per year

Solvent tenant with established business

Sale price: €975,000

Important:
To access detailed documentation and arrange any visits, it will be necessary to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) beforehand.

Contact us for more information.

High profitability. Solid contract. Ideal product for investors.
